source_full_text: They thought he had found it, And asked no more questions. When Niels left the castle, he shut the door behind him, And it closed with such a bang that the porter woke up. He could scarcely believe his eyes when he saw the three headless giants lying in a heap in the courtyard, And could not imagine what had taken place.

reference_text: 他们以为他找到了，便不再追问。尼尔斯离开城堡时，关上了身后的门，门关上的声音如此响亮，以至于守门人被惊醒了。当他看到三个无头巨人堆在院子里时，几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛，完全想象不出发生了什么事。
